sentence: AI capabilities bring value by strengthening the firm's ability to adjust to market change, and that adaptive response then lifts firm performance and innovation
passage: [Sullivan & Fosso Wamba (2024), p. 1] "This research examines how AI-powered capabilities can bring value to organizations by enhancing their Adaptive Response to Market Changes (ARMC)." / "we find that ARMC positively influences firm performance and innovation."

gemini.note: The sentence presents the first half of the claim as a finding, but the passage frames it only as a research aim, while empirically confirming only the second half.
